FN-SOEE55-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 486
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Laura Hall
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 05/19/2023
House Bill 486 as introduced would exempt certain procurement contracts of the Alabama
Women's Tribute Statue Commission from the competitive bidding process which could
increase or decrease the potential obligations of the Commission by an undetermined amount,
dependent on the difference in (1) the amount of the contract entered under the provisions of this
bill and (2) the amount of the contract otherwise obtained under current law.
Page 1

FN-SOEE55-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 486
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Representative Laura Hall
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 06/01/2023
House Bill 486 as passed the House of Representatives would exempt certain procurement
contracts of the Alabama Women's Tribute Statue Commission from the competitive bidding
process which could increase or decrease the potential obligations of the Commission by an
undetermined amount, dependent on the difference in (1) the amount of the contract entered
under the provisions of this bill and (2) the amount of the contract otherwise obtained under
current law.
In addition, this bill increases the administrative obligations of the Finance Director, by an
undetermined amount to approve contracts, as authorized pursuant to the provisions of this bill,
prior to the expenditure of funds.
